cmd = "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/plot_multi_specimen_v1_7.py 1 600 0 " \
      "storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v40_specimen.json " \
      "storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v41_specimen.json " \
      "storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json"

    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
    print("RUN_V17_RC", rc)
